title: [Feature Request] Lock/Hide OpenAPS SMB in config builder until Obj 9 has been completed
symptom: New users can select OpenAPS SMB in config builder from the beginning, even though SMBs are not yet possible, causing the algorithm to shut off basal during meal bolus window and guaranteeing post meal highs.
evidence_quote: If a new user mistakenly selects OpenAPS SMB from the beginning, the algorithm will shut off basal during meal bolus window, guaranteeing post meal highs because SMBs are not yet possible.
